name: settings
description: Changes Morrow's own settings when asked -- answer length, mood, language, how much she remembers, and where the overlay sits on screen.
triggers: I want your answers to be longer.
Can you move to the top left of my screen?
Move yourself to the bottom right corner.
Be more cheerful from now on.
Talk to me in French from now on.
Go sit in the top right corner.
Your answers are too long, cut them down.
